Miss Yonge would be obliged to [Mr Collier](/person/356) if he would reserve a ticket for her for each day of the Conference.[^1] She encloses stamps for 5/


[^1]: The Hampshire Diocesan Conference in Winchester, which opened on Tuesday 26 June 1877.
